note: communityType is an id from community_types.json. platformTypes lists cost types from cost_rules.json: one entry is pre-filled; several are recommended, and the person picks one. structuralModels: what each structural model means (the docs' Structural models table). A generic row's otherSoftware: common software that implements its protocol but isn't a row of its own.

structuralModels.description: A single operator controls all data and infrastructure. The platform is one server (or cluster) owned and operated by one entity.
Multiple independently-operated servers interoperate via a shared open protocol. Each server is autonomous; users on different servers can still interact.
Messages are broadcast through relay nodes. Clients choose which relays to connect to and read from. There is no canonical server — the network is the relays.
Uses elements of both models. AT Protocol uses PDS-to-PDS federation for data storage, plus a relay layer (the firehose) for real-time distribution.
A proprietary or institutionally-controlled platform built on top of a federation protocol. The platform itself is not self-hostable, but it interoperates with the broader protocol ecosystem.
